caption: The drawing shows two detailed, shaded renderings of a cylindrical metal object that has a vertical rod passing through its center; the first view on the left is an isometric angle of just the cylinder, and the second on the right shows a full side view, including a long handle attached to one end of the rod. The cylindrical component has a small latched door, depicted on the front of both views, with a rectangular cutout above it, possibly for ventilation or viewing, and rivets visible along its edge. The rod extends vertically above and below the cylinder, with the lower end shown as a point. The handle shown in the right view is contoured and appears wood-textured; it is attached to the upper end of the vertical rod. The artwork is rendered in black and white pencil or charcoal on a beige or light tan background. There is a double-line rectangular border around the entire drawing. Below the main subjects, there is a scale marked in inches and a label reading “I.S. BORRAZZO.”
title: Fireplace Coffee Roaster
